title: Swanson: For Derwin James Jr. and the Chargers, winning over L.A. starts with playoff success

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Swanson: For Derwin James Jr. and the Chargers, winning over L.A. starts with playoff success
sources.description: Derwin James Jr., the outstanding safety for the Chargers, doesn't get the recognition he deserves. Winning in the playoffs would go a long way to reversing that.
